name: Vinati Organics Ltd
about: Vinati Organics Ltd is an integrated B2B manufacturer of the specialty monomers, aromatics, butyl phenols, antioxidants, polymers and inorganic /specialty intermediates, with four manufacturing sites in Maharashtra and exports to global chemical customers.[1]
keyPoints: Product Offerings:[1] The company’s product portfolio includes over 30 products across: a) Specialty Aromatics:[2] It offers Iso butyl benzene (IBB), N-Butyl Benzene, Secondary Butyl Benzene (SBB), Tertiary Amyl Benzene, and other intermediates used to manufacture pharmaceutical products, flavor and fragrance ingredients, polymer additives, and more. b) Specialty Monomers:[3] It offers a range of chemicals like 2-acrylamido 2-methyl Propane Sulphonic Acid (ATBS), N-Tertiary Butyl Acrylamide, N-Tertiary Octyl Acrylamide, etc. that are used for designing unique polymer structures. c) Butyl Phenols:[4] It manufactures Ortho Tertiary Butyl Phenol/2 Tert Butylphenol, Para Tertiary Butyl Phenol, 2, 6 Di Tert Butylphenol, etc. d) Antioxidants:[5] It offers Veenox 1010, Veenox 1076, Veenox 168, antioxidant blends, etc. e) Miscellaneous Polymers:[6] The company produces Miscellaneous Polymers like Vintreat Polymer, Vinplast 245, Vinflow HT, etc used in specialized applications such as construction, ceramics, etc. f) Inorganic Chemicals:[7] It also manufactures potassium bicarbonate used across industries, from food processing to healthcare. g) New Products: VOPL’s new chain includes anisole, MEHQ, guaiacol, BHA, 4-MAP, PTAP, 2,4-DTAP and tertiary-amyl alcohol.
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 20.5%
